question: top 5 categories with most open places
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS places FROM lisbon_places WHERE operating_status = 'open' GROUP BY basic_category ORDER BY places DESC LIMIT 5

question: nearest open restaurant to Praça do Comércio
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_DistanceSphere(geometry, ST_MakePoint(-9.1393, 38.7079)) AS meters FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND operating_status = 'open' QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ST_DistanceSphere(geometry, ST_MakePoint(-9.1393, 38.7079))) = 1

question: places within 500m of Belém Tower with website
sql: WITH pt AS (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_MakePoint(-9.2167, 38.6916), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true) AS p) SELECT id, names.primary AS name, basic_category FROM lisbon_places, pt WHERE array_length(websites, 1) > 0 AND ST_Distance(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), p) <= 500

question: categories with avg confidence >0.85 and at least 100 places
sql: SELECT basic_category, ROUND(AVG(confidence), 3) AS avg_confidence, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY basic_category HAVING AVG(confidence) > 0.85 AND COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_confidence DESC

question: confidence tiers for open wellness services
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN confidence >= 0.9 THEN 'high' WHEN confidence >= 0.7 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS confidence_tier, COUNT(*) AS places FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'wellness_service' AND operating_status = 'open' GROUP BY confidence_tier ORDER BY confidence_tier

question: permanently closed historic sites high confidence geojson
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, confidence, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_places WHERE operating_status = 'permanently_closed' AND taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' AND confidence > 0.8
